questions.question: In a prophet's song about a fruitful vineyard, who is the keeper of the vineyard?
In a prophet's song about God's vineyard, what does the LORD say He would do if thorns and briers confronted Him?

answers.text: Trample them and burn them down
Let them grow next to the vines

questions.question: In the days to come, what will happen to Israel, pictured as a plant, in Isaiah's prophecy?

answers.text: It takes root and fills the world with fruit
It stays small and hidden in one field
It blooms once but never bears any fruit

questions.question: When a great ram's horn sounds and people from Assyria and Egypt come forth, where will they worship the LORD?

answers.text: On the holy mountain in Jerusalem
At the altar in the city of Bethel
In a temple in the land of Egypt
